title: Enable QR Control and set the default QR code settings
summary: Turn on QR Control so every connected display shows a QR code that visitors scan to choose and play triggered campaigns.
bodyMd:
QR Control shows a unique QR code on every connected display. When a visitor scans it, their phone lists every active triggered campaign running on that display; selecting one plays it on the display. Enable QR Control once at platform level after you have created your first triggered campaign.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with the Admin role.
  • At least 1 triggered campaign — see What are triggered campaigns?
  • A mobile site template for the campaign list to open in — see Define your default mobile site template.

Enable QR Control at platform level

  1. In the left navigation, select Platform Admin.
  2. Under Enabled Features, select QR Control.
  3. Set Enable QR-Control on Connected Store Displays to on.

Enable the QR-Control touch-point on each triggered campaign

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns, then select the campaign's name.
  2. On the Campaign Brief tab, under ENABLED TOUCH-POINT(S), set QR-Control to on.
  3. Select Update Campaign Brief.

Set the default QR code settings

The default size, colour and position apply to every landscape and portrait display that does not have its own override.

  1. In the left navigation, select Displays & Devices, then select Manage Display Types.
  2. In the row for the display type (for example Landscape or Portrait), open the … menu and select View/Edit.
  3. Set the default QR code size, colour and position for that display type, then save.

Each store also has a QR Control - Mobile Site Template field on its Store Details tab. It chooses which mobile site template opens when a visitor scans a QR code in that store.

Verify it worked

Every connected display shows a QR code. Scan it with a phone: the mobile site opens with a carousel of the triggered campaigns active on that display, and selecting one starts it on the display.

Troubleshooting

The QR code is missing on one display

Cause. QR Control is switched off for that display.

Fix. Open the display in Displays & Devices, select the Enabled Features tab and tick Enable QR Control — see Enable QR Control on a display.

The visitor sees no campaigns after scanning

Cause. No triggered campaign is active with the QR-Control touch-point enabled for that display's playlist.

Fix. Activate the campaign and check its Campaign Brief has QR-Control on and the display's playlist under Digital Signage.
